question: Which underexamined Next strategy has the weakest causal stressed return per occupied hour across the four existing portfolio control periods, with enough breadth and sample to justify the next strategy-specific development unit without reducing any base entry?
hypothesis: At least one of RC16, RC4, or Pressure has nonpositive slot value in multiple periods and a sufficiently large completed sample to be a higher-information next target than another Cross, Return, Passive, or shared-capital mechanism.

scope.selection_universe_reason: The existing Next Frontier ledger already retains direct Cross, Return, Passive, slot-price, and capital-transition mechanisms; RC16, RC4, and Pressure have no retained direct strategy-specific mechanism.

reconstruction_contract.source_rows: all events-*.csv files under each fixed control root, ordered by server_time then state_sequence
reconstruction_contract.stressed_net: numeric value_b on the lifecycle-end row
reconstruction_contract.occupied_hours: server_time difference from paired lifecycle start to end
reconstruction_contract.integrity_gate: no duplicate event rows after exact-row deduplication, no negative duration, and no unmatched completed close; any violation makes the unit INVALID

selection_order: lowest pooled stressed net per occupied hour

verdicts.target_identified: Exactly one eligible RC16, RC4, or Pressure strategy is selected by the frozen order.
verdicts.no_target: No underexamined strategy meets every eligibility gate.

next_boundary: Close this source-free diagnostic with one machine result. A selected strategy opens only a later sibling family for causal economic decomposition; this unit creates no mechanism and cannot claim Live suitability.
